summary: Texas list marks Wolf Hill (Loc 2), a tower in Angelina County, as gone; no source found gives its build, staffing or removal.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on the Texas lookout list. No source read for this record describes what remains at the site now.

notes_for_editor: Index-only record: the Texas list gives name, county, coordinates, type (Tower) and status (Gone) and nothing more. Two searches and page reads found no build, design, height, staffing or removal detail for either Wolf Hill site. The Lufkin Daily News tower article returned HTTP 429 twice and the TFS history page returned 403. The SFA photo records cover Cyclone Hill, not Wolf Hill, so they are not used. The Loc 1 and Loc 2 labels are not explained by the index, and it does not say whether both towers stood at the same time. Confidence low.
